modifiers.detail: amateur motorsport competition (club saloon racing, 14 events/yr)

drivers: moving violations in the last 3 years
rationale: Build, BP, lipids, A1c, tobacco, family history and financial multiple are clean. Debits for class C occupation, diagnosed sleep apnea, elevated liver enzymes and two moving violations total to Table 6. Club saloon racing carries the motorsport flat extra, $5.00 per $1,000. Hazardous occupation with hazardous avocation, borderline liver chemistry and CPAP-treated apnea are referral points; no referral available, so I used judgement and applied each table as written, charging both the occupation debit and the motorsport extra.
